caption:
A missed call doesn't have to mean a lost job.

Most shops let it ring, let it hit voicemail, and hope the caller tries again. They don't. They call the next business on the list.

The fix is a text that fires the second you miss the call. Write it like this:

1. Lead with your business name
2. Apologize in one short line
3. Ask ONE question that moves the job forward
4. Close with "Reply STOP to opt out"

Set the trigger to fire immediately, not at end of day. Route every reply to one real person who answers. If the caller stays quiet, send a second nudge three days later before you write the lead off.
